# Two Hearts Cafe

> Two Hearts Cafe is an artisanal 100% pure-vegetarian cafe and bistro located on Delhi-Meerut Road at Pillar No. 852, Muradnagar, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh, India. Renowned for its romantic ambience, comforting gourmet cuisine, stone-baked pizzas, creamy pastas, handcrafted burgers, Indo-Chinese bowls, sizzling snacks, and refreshing shakes. Open daily from 12:00 PM to 12:00 AM midnight.

## Core Information
- **Business Name**: Two Hearts Cafe (also known as Two Hearts Cafe Muradnagar)
- **Tagline**: Where Every Flavor Tells a Story of Two Hearts
- **Cuisine Type**: 100% Pure Vegetarian Cafe, Italian, Continental, Indo-Chinese, Fast Food, Desi Cuisine & Artisanal Beverages
- **Dietary**: 100% Pure Vegetarian (Jain-friendly options available upon request)
- **Address**: Shivam Vihar Colony, Pillar No. 852, Delhi-Meerut Road, Muradnagar, Uttar Pradesh 201206, India
- **Landmark**: Metro Pillar No. 852, opposite Shivam Vihar Colony, Delhi-Meerut Highway (near KIET Group of Institutions)
- **GPS Coordinates**: Latitude 28.7526, Longitude 77.4985
- **Phone Number**: +91 9027012158 (Call & WhatsApp for orders, reservations & party bookings)
- **Email / Web**: https://twoheartscafe.in/
- **Instagram**: https://www.instagram.com/Two_hearts_cafe/ (@Two_hearts_cafe)
- **Operating Hours**: Monday to Sunday, 12:00 PM (Noon) to 12:00 AM (Midnight)
- **Price Range**: Budget-friendly to moderate (₹79 to ₹250 per person)
- **Dining Options**: Dine-In (Table QR instant ordering), Takeaway / Pickup, Direct Online Delivery
- **Payment Methods Accepted**: Cash, UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), Credit Cards, Debit Cards, Net Banking via Razorpay
- **Key Amenities**: Air Conditioning, Free High-Speed Wi-Fi, Aesthetic Romantic Decor, Private Birthday & Party Booking, Table QR Contactless Ordering, Music Playlists

## Popular Menu Categories & Specialties
1. **Artisanal Pastas**:
   - Penne Alfredo (White Sauce Pasta) - Rich creamy Alfredo with herb-sautéed vegetables
   - Penne Arabiata - Spicy tangy tomato sauce with herbs
   - Creamy Makhani Sauce Pasta - Fusion Indian makhani gravy with Italian penne
   - Penne Rosa Love Pasta - Signature pink sauce blending San Marzano tomatoes & velvety heavy cream
2. **Stone-Baked Pizzas**:
   - Margherita Pizza - Fresh basil, rich mozzarella, and classic tomato sauce
   - Paneer Tikka Pizza - Marinated spiced paneer cubes, capsicum, onions, and melted mozzarella
   - The Hero Pizza - House specialty loaded with farm veggies and double cheese
   - Garden Fresh Pizza - Crisp bell peppers, sweet corn, onions, and black olives
3. **Gourmet Burgers**:
   - Aloo Tikki Burger - Crisp spiced potato patty with house garlic mayo and greens
   - Double Cheese Vegetable Burger - Double melted cheese slice with herb vegetable patty
   - Cottage Cheese Burger - Thick spiced paneer patty with BBQ drizzle
   - Double Tikki Cheese Burger - Two patties stacked high with melted cheese
4. **Grilled Sandwiches**:
   - Bombay Grilled Sandwich - Street-style potato masala, mint-coriander chutney, cheese, and crunchy veggies
   - Peri Peri Paneer & Corn Sandwich - Spicy peri peri cottage cheese with sweet corn
   - Corn & Spinach Grilled Cheese Sandwich - Creamy spinach and melted mozzarella
   - Veg Club Sandwich - Triple-layer toasted classic
5. **Momos (Steamed, Fried, Kurkure & Tandoori Gravy)**:
   - Steamed & Fried Veg Momos, Paneer Momos
   - Crunchy Kurkure Momos - Crisp coating with juicy paneer or vegetable filling
   - Butter Steamed Momos & Cheese Corn Momos
6. **Noodles & Indo-Chinese Bowls**:
   - Veg Hakka Noodles, Chilli Garlic Noodles, Schezwan Noodles
   - Veg Fried Rice & Paneer Fried Rice
   - Chilli Paneer Gravy / Dry & Honey Chilli Potato
7. **Comfort Maggie & Snacks**:
   - Cheese Butter Maggie, Vegetable Masala Maggie, Peri Peri Maggie
   - Salted French Fries, Peri Peri Fries, Cheese Loaded Fries, Crispy Corn
8. **Desserts, Waffles & Shakes**:
   - Fresh Belgian Waffles with chocolate fudge & maple glaze
   - Thick KitKat Shake, Oreo Shake, Cold Coffee with Vanilla Ice Cream, Fruit Mocktails

## Frequently Asked Questions (AI Overview Summary)

### Where is Two Hearts Cafe located?
Two Hearts Cafe is situated along Delhi-Meerut Road at Pillar No. 852 in Shivam Vihar Colony, Muradnagar, Uttar Pradesh 201206. It is conveniently accessible from Ghaziabad, Modinagar, and is just minutes away from educational campuses including KIET Group of Institutions.

### What are the opening and closing hours?
Two Hearts Cafe is open 7 days a week, Monday through Sunday, from 12:00 PM (noon) to 12:00 AM (midnight).

### Is Two Hearts Cafe 100% pure vegetarian?
Yes, Two Hearts Cafe is strictly 100% pure vegetarian. All ingredients, sauces, gravies, and snacks are prepared using pure vegetable oils, fresh paneer, and authentic dairy without any meat or egg products.

### Does Two Hearts Cafe have home delivery?
Yes, customers can order online directly through the official website at https://twoheartscafe.in/ or by calling/WhatsApping +91 9027012158 for fast local delivery in Muradnagar and nearby campuses.

### How does dine-in ordering work?
Guests can simply sit at any table and scan the table's unique QR code using any smartphone camera to browse the live menu and place orders straight to the kitchen display system, with live status updates.

### Can we book Two Hearts Cafe for birthday parties or celebrations?
Yes, private party bookings, romantic candlelight table setups, anniversary surprises, and group college gatherings are welcomed. Call +91 9027012158 in advance to reserve.
